stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper analyses the causal interdependencies among seven barriers/challenges to EnMS adoption by Brazilian companies using fuzzy DEMATEL, a multi-criteria decision-making method. It presents, proposes, evaluates or critiques no EnPI/EnB measurement model; 'performance indicators' appears only as challenge IT2 (difficulty in determining them), an incidental mention with no model identified or characterised. Per Stage 1, a framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content is ineligible.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The fuzzy Decision-Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory (DEMATEL) methodology is employed to examine the interdependencies between the challenges.

stage1.notes: Fuzzy DEMATEL analysis of 7 EnMS-adoption barriers; no EnPI/EnB model. paper_type='other' (MCDM barrier study fits no energy-model category); not a review, so not borderline.
